thread:
Aisha: Quick follow-up from the DB outage postmortem — we keep drifting on action closures. I want to propose tightening the follow-up process: a 2-week owner SLA for remediation, a recurring-pattern review every quarter, and a small timeline template for each PM/owner. Thoughts?

Ben: +1 to a shorter SLA. Can we add a single tracker (spreadsheet or GH issue board) and require owners to update status weekly? Makes audits easier.

Carlos: Agree. Here's a minimal timeline template we can copy into PMs/prod docs:
```
- Incident ID: 
- Short summary (1 line): 
- Owner: 
- Action description: 
- Due date (2-week SLA): 
- Status checkpoints: day 3, day 7, day 14 
- Rollout/validation plan: 
- Recurrence check window: quarterly
```

Devon: Also propose a comms cadence: initial incident summary in 1 hour, postmortem draft in 48h, actionable follow-ups assigned in 72h, and weekly status blips until closure. Make status blips a single line (owner: eta).

Jia: For IC rotation — let's formalize monthly rotation with a shared calendar and a lightweight handoff doc (2 bullets: current risks, on-going mitigations). I'll start a calendar and a recurring 30m sign-up.

incident-bot: Reminder created: follow-up tracker created at https://go.redwood/internal/trackers/incident-actions (owner updates required). Next reminder in 7 days.

Aisha: Thanks. Action items from this thread: assign temporary owners to the four open postmortem actions by EOD, Carlos to add timeline template to /docs/incidents, Jia to publish IC rotation calendar invite, Ben to spin up the tracker (or point to existing) and give edit rights. I'll check compliance at the 2-week mark.

Ben: I'll create the GH board now and add weekly checklist items.

Carlos: Added template to docs and linked the PR in the tracker.

Devon: We'll add the comms cadence to the incident runbook and call it out in the next all-hands.

Jia: Calendar invite sent for monthly IC rotation; first rotation starts next Monday.

Aisha: Cool. Can everyone paste progress updates in this thread once per week until all assigned actions are closed? Short lines only please (owner: status).

Ben: Ben: done (created board, added owners).

Carlos: Carlos: template merged, filed two actions, owners assigned.

Jia: Jia: calendar invite accepted by all oncall, handoff doc template added.

Devon: Devon: runbook updated, comms cadence section added.

Aisha: Thanks all — we'll revisit recurrence audits in 3 months. :thumbsup:
